about_the_game:
Forget mercy. Forget salvation. There is nothing here but blood, steel, and light from cannons.

In a world where ancient Slavic rites are intertwined with the ashes of future technology, you are the last warrior of the Varangian Guard. Against you - hordes of cyber-mutants, obsessed cultists and traitors that sold their flesh and faith for the power of the dark cult.

  • A real boomer-shooter - old-school gameplay in the spirit of DOOM II, Duke Nukem and Quake. No cover, no reloading. It's just you and your speed.

  • Cult tech - an arsenal ranging from axes and archaic shotguns to and damn futuristic cannons.

  • Grimdark universe - inspired by Eastern Slavic myths, Varangian culture, and crazy techno-cult.

  • Grim enemies - from cultists, stormtroopers, magi, to cybernatchers.

  • Grim locations - Forgotten kapis, industrial necropolises, ancient citadels and throne rooms.

  • Soundtrack - Classic heavy metal mixed with industrial music

content_descriptors.notes: The game showcases pixelated blood, with enemies getting bloody wounds.
